snippet.title: Cairn - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Time to climb! The game is available now. https://bit.ly/Cairn-Steam / https://bit.ly/Cairn-PS5Store

https://thegamebakers.carrd.co/

As pro climber Aava, you set out to conquer the legendary Mount Kami. Experience the challenge and exhilaration of climbing as you scale the vertiginous cliffs. Climb anywhere and plan your route carefully, managing resources along the expedition.The whole mountain is yours to explore, filled with unexpected encounters and long lost mysteries. This is what you trained for: pushing beyond your limits, in a quest for absolute freedom.
